summary: Iter65 Stock manual overrides tested end-to-end. Backend: 13 pytest cases (SET/GET/DELETE override, persistence after POST /api/stock upsert, validation 422/400/404, RBAC 403 commercial+technicien, unauthenticated) -> 12 pass, 1 fail (cascade of besoin override to derived columns). Frontend: admin Stock page loads, inline edit + amber badge + pencil + tooltip (auteur/date/auto) + revert all work for besoin, stock_previsionnel and reste_a_commander; Escape/cancel works; commercial gets backend 403 with toast.

minor.issue: reste_a_commander_auto / stock_previsionnel_auto are computed from besoin_auto instead of the effective (overridden) besoin. With override besoin=42, stock_disponible=5, commande=0 the table still shows À commander=0 and status green/orange, contradicting the on-screen formula 'À commander = max(0, Besoin - Stock physique - Commande en cours)'. Admin must override 3 columns manually to get a coherent row.

Returns 403 for commercial as designed, but response body is only a toast-triggering error; the frontend still renders the full empty Stock table instead of a dedicated 'Accès refusé' state (see frontend issues).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the pencil on a non-overridden 'Besoin chantiers' cell immediately PUTs an override equal to the current auto value (saveOverride(r,'besoin',r.besoin)) instead of opening the inline input. Result: an unwanted traced override (amber badge + author/date) is created on a simple click, and the user needs a 2nd pencil click to actually type a value. Prévisionnel / À commander open the inline input correctly on first click — behaviour is inconsistent.

issues: 403 from API shows a red toast 'Accès refusé (stock réservé au responsable / technicien)' but the page still renders header, KPI cards and empty table — expected a clear 'Accès refusé' screen per spec

action_items: Decide/fix cascade: compute reste_a_commander_auto and stock_previsionnel_auto from the effective besoin (besoin_eff) so overriding Besoin updates the derived columns and the status colour, or update the footer formula text to state that overrides do not cascade.
Make the Besoin pencil open the inline input (reuse OverrideCell editing state) instead of writing an override with the current value on first click.
Render an explicit 'Accès refusé' state on /stock when GET /api/stock returns 403 (commercial).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_stock: reste_auto/prev_auto use besoin_auto; move them after besoin_eff resolution to keep the displayed formula true.
Stock.jsx duplicates the Besoin cell rendering logic outside OverrideCell (~40 lines) — merge the drill-down button into OverrideCell to avoid the divergent click behaviour.
server.py is very large (>6000 lines) — split stock/planning/sales routers into modules.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_Override_Iter65 (pytest fixture) and TEST_UI_Override65 (UI test, deleted after run). Stock collection back to its original single row 'Système anti-incendie'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite for overrides: /app/backend/tests/test_stock_override_iter65.py (one intentionally failing test documents the non-cascading besoin override). Frontend testids confirmed: stock-besoin-{key}[-edit-btn|-input|-confirm|-cancel|-revert], stock-previsionnel-{key}..., stock-reste-{key}.... Frontend URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000.
rca_of_the_issue: In list_stock, reste_auto = max(0, besoin_auto - dispo - commande) and prev_auto = dispo + commande - besoin_auto are computed before overrides are applied; only their own explicit overrides can change them, so a besoin override never propagates. On the frontend, the non-overridden Besoin cell has a bespoke pencil handler that calls saveOverride with the current value instead of switching OverrideCell into editing mode.
